title: Replace payroll tax with broader, more efficient taxes
action: Over time, replace state payroll taxes with revenue from broad-based taxes, such as land tax or a broad consumption or cash-flow tax. In the meantime, align payroll tax rules and administration across states and consider relief for new businesses in their first years.
why: Payroll tax falls only on firms above a threshold, so it discourages small firms from growing past it and differs from state to state, adding compliance costs for businesses that operate nationally.

evidence.source: Australia's Future Tax System: Report to the Treasurer, Part One (Henry review)
evidence.quote: State payroll taxes should eventually be replaced with revenue from more efficient broad-based taxes that capture the value-add of labour.

evidence.source: NSW Productivity Commission White Paper 2021: Rebooting the economy
evidence.quote: Coordinate payroll tax administration across states and territories and identify options to alleviate the impact on startups from payroll tax for the first five years of operation.

tradeoffs: Payroll tax is the largest state tax, so replacing it needs a broad alternative and probably agreement with the Commonwealth. Thresholds help small firms but cause the growth penalty.
